title: isopogon teretifolius var. corniger
intro: Isopogon teretifolius var. corniger, commonly known as the Coning Isopogon, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. It is a shrub native to Australia, known for its potential health benefits and traditional uses. The therapeutic actions of Isopogon teretifolius var. corniger include its ability to act as a diuretic and to reduce inflammation, making it useful for treating conditions such as urinary tract infections and arthritis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include terpenoids and sesquiterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
